title: Lifting solutions of polynomial equations on matrices over field to complete local principal ideal rings
summary: Let $\widehat{\mathscr O}$ be a complete local principal ideal ring with residue field $k$ of characteristic not $2$ and $f\in \widehat{\mathscr O}[x_1,x_2,\dots,x_m]$. Take $A\in \mathrm M_n(\widehat{\mathscr O})$ with its reduction $\overline{A}\in \mathrm M_n(k)$. In this article, we study the following lifting problem. Suppose there exists a tuple $(\widetilde{B}_1, \widetilde{B}_2, \dots,\widetilde{B}_m)\in \mathrm M_n(k)^m$ of pairwise commuting matrices such that $f(\widetilde{B}_1, \widetilde{B}_2, \dots,\widetilde{B}_m) = \overline{A}$; under what conditions can this solution be…
